name: Microsoft Azure AI Fundamentals

fee.note: Microsoft prices by exam country/region; the exam page shows the price for your location, before taxes. Students and educators can schedule through Certiport.

exam.format: Proctored 45-minute Fundamentals exam through Pearson VUE (Certiport for students and educators). Microsoft does not publish the question count or question types per exam.

scope: AI concepts and responsible AI, models and common AI workloads, and building simple generative AI, agent, text, speech, vision and information-extraction apps with Microsoft Foundry. Python syntax and Azure familiarity are expected.
ai_policy: Check the current assessment rules. AI-assisted study does not imply permission during the exam.
caveats: AI-901 replaced AI-900, which retired on June 30, 2026; both lead to Microsoft Certified: Azure AI Fundamentals, but the skills outlines differ, so AI-900 study material does not match this exam.
Microsoft says most of its exams have 40–60 questions but does not publish the count for AI-901.
The AI-901 page does not state the exam length; 45 minutes is Microsoft's published length for Fundamentals exams.

domains.name: Implement AI solutions by using Microsoft Foundry

prep.title: Microsoft Learn: Introduction to AI in Azure (AI-901T00)
prep.note: Self-paced learning paths are free; the instructor-led delivery is paid.

prep.title: Official AI-901 practice assessment
prep.note: On AI Skills Navigator; needs a sign-in.

domains_note: Weights are the midpoints of the ranges in the Microsoft Learn AI-901 study guide (40–45%, 55–60%; skills measured as of April 15, 2026), rounded to whole numbers that add up to 100. The rounding tie goes to the larger domain. Read 2026-11-17.
